description: Top 20 U.S. Gateways for Nonstop International Air Travel is a dataset listed in data.bts.gov (Bureau of Transportation Statistics open data), an open data portal of the Bureau of Transportation Statistics under the section "Research and Statistics", published or maintained by Bureau of Transportation Statistics. This data identifies the premier hubs connecting the United States to the rest of the globe. These 'gateways' are the critical nodes where international nonstop flights land and depart, serving as the primary ports of entry for global trade and tourism. Coverage: United States (see the dataset for state or local subsets). The portal files it under "Research and Statistics". It has 4 columns, among them 2023, 2022, Gateway airport, %Change 2022 - 2023. The portal shows 2026-02-25 as the last data update. Attribution given: Bureau of Transportation Statistics. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is U.S. federal government work, public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, safety and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-bts-data-bts-gov-portal.
